welcome.description: Open a local question bank to view reference answers.
folderGuide.title: Where are my question files?
folderGuide.windowsInstruction: Press Win + R, paste the path, and press Enter.
folderGuide.androidInstruction: Android may restrict access to this folder. If necessary, import an accessible copy or ZIP archive.
folderGuide.copyFailure: Could not copy. Select the path and copy it manually.
folderGuide.disclaimer: Locations may vary by app version and device.
import.errors.emptyFolder: No files were returned. Select a question-bank folder or Import ZIP.
import.errors.folderEntries: Folder entry limit exceeded. Import a smaller bank.
import.errors.relativePaths: This browser did not return folder-relative paths. Use Import ZIP to preserve the complete bank.
import.errors.incompletePaths: Folder paths are incomplete. Use Import ZIP.
import.errors.inconsistentRoots: Folder paths have inconsistent roots. Use Import ZIP.
import.errors.folderSize: Folder size limit (1 GiB) exceeded. Select a smaller bank.
import.errors.dataSize: Data file exceeds the 32 MiB parsing limit
import.errors.worker: The import worker could not complete. Try a smaller bank or a current browser.
import.errors.browser: This browser could not start local processing. Try a current browser.
import.errors.unknown: Unable to import this bank. Check the files and try again.
import.errors.zip.invalid: The ZIP archive is invalid or unsupported. Re-create it and try again.
import.errors.zip.multiVolume: Invalid ZIP: multi-volume archives are unsupported
import.errors.zip.zip64: Invalid ZIP: ZIP64 archives are unsupported
import.errors.zip.encoding: Invalid ZIP: filename encoding must be UTF-8; re-create the ZIP with Unicode filenames
import.errors.zip.compression: Invalid ZIP: encrypted or unsupported compression
import.errors.zip.symlinks: Invalid ZIP: symbolic links are unsupported
import.errors.zip.sizeCrc: Invalid ZIP: local size or CRC mismatch
import.errors.zip.decompression: Invalid ZIP: actual decompression limit exceeded
